tool.name: Beacon2 CNV
tool.description: find copy number variants from federated beacons or a self-hosted database
tool.command: #if str($connection.transport) == "api" #set $filters = $connection.filters beacon2-query cnv @PROVIDER_ARGS@ --reference-name '$connection.reference_name' --assembly '$connection.assembly' --start $connection.start --end $connection.end --granularity '$connection.granularity' --limit $connection.pagination.limit --skip $connection.pagination.skip #if str($connection.pagination.sample) --sample $connection.pagination.sample #end if #if str($connection.cnv_terms.variant_type.mode) == "efo" --class-term 'CNV=$connection.cnv_terms.variant_type.term' --expand-hierarchy '$connection.cnv_terms.variant_type.expand_hierarchy' #elif str($connection.cnv_terms.variant_type.mode) != "none" --class-term 'CNV=$connection.cnv_terms.variant_type.term' #end if @FILTER_ARGS@ @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #else beacon2-query cnv --transport mongodb --db-host '$connection.db_host' --db-port $connection.db_port --database '$connection.database' --collection '$connection.collection' --credentials-file '$credentials' --stored-coordinates #if str($connection.chromosome) --reference-name '$connection.chromosome' #end if #if str($connection.start) --start $connection.start #end if #if str($connection.end) --end $connection.end #end if #if str($connection.variantType) --variant-type '$connection.variantType' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.variantInternalId) --field 'variantInternalId=$connection.mongo_fields.variantInternalId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.analysisId) --field 'analysisId=$connection.mongo_fields.analysisId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.individualId) --field 'individualId=$connection.mongo_fields.individualId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.gene) --field 'gene=$connection.mongo_fields.gene' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.primarySite) --field 'primarySite=$connection.mongo_fields.primarySite' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.diseaseType) --field 'diseaseType=$connection.mongo_fields.diseaseType' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.variantStateId) --field 'variantState.id=$connection.mongo_fields.variantStateId' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.variantState) --field 'variantState.label=$connection.mongo_fields.variantState' #end if #if str($connection.mongo_fields.sequenceId) --field 'definitions.Location.sequenceId=$connection.mongo_fields.sequenceId' #end if @OUTPUT_ARGS@ #end if

param.name: reference_name
param.label: Chromosome
param.help: 17, chr17 or NC_000017.11 are all accepted.

param.name: start
param.label: START
param.help: As stored in the database, exactly as the 2.2.x tool took it. A CNV must start at or after this.

param.name: end
param.label: END
param.help: As stored in the database. A CNV must end at or before this.

section.name: mongo_fields
section.title: Further fields (each one exact; all must match)

param.name: gene
param.label: GENE NAME
param.help: Gene name e.g. 'AL645728.1' Matched exactly against gene.

param.name: primarySite
param.label: PRIMARY SITE
param.help: Primary Site, e.g. 'brain' Matched exactly against primarySite.

param.name: diseaseType
param.label: DISEASE TYPE
param.help: Disease Type, e.g. 'adnexal and skin appendage neoplasms' Matched exactly against diseaseType.

param.name: sequenceId
param.label: SEQUENCE ID
param.help: E.g. refseq:NC_000011.10 Matched exactly against definitions.Location.sequenceId.

tool.help:
**What it does**
@HELP_READS@
Finds copy number variants on the beacons you select, or in a self-hosted Beacon MongoDB database. It carries every field the 2.2.x CNV tool offered.
**The two connections match positions differently**
On a *self-hosted MongoDB*, start and end are taken exactly as stored, and a CNV matches if it lies **within** them: it starts at or after the start and ends at or before the end. That is the 2.2.x behaviour, unchanged, so existing analyses, including the GTN CNV tutorial, give the same results.
On the *Beacon v2 API*, positions are 1-based and the query is a Beacon range query, which matches any CNV that **overlaps** the region at all. The same window can therefore return more on the API than from MongoDB.
**Two ways to narrow a query, one per connection**
On the *Beacon v2 API* the tool takes **filters**: ontology terms such as ``NCIT:C3058``, which each beacon maps onto its own records. The API has no way to match a field's value directly.
On a *self-hosted MongoDB* the tool takes **fields**: the same named fields the 2.2.x tools offered, each matched exactly against a document path shown in its help. A raw collection has no mapping from ontology terms to fields, so filters are not offered there.
@HELP_CNV_TERMS@
@HELP_OUTPUTS@
